newsitem.title: USA: American Precision to buy Portescap SA.
newsitem.headline: American Precision to buy Portescap SA.

text.p: American Precision Industries Inc said Tuesday it agreed to acquire Portescap SA from Inter Scan Holding Ag for convertible preferred stock, an exchangeable note and cash valued at $60 million.
The acquisition of the Swiss maker of micro motors will be accretive to earnings from the beginning, American Precision chief executive Kurt Wiedenhaupt told Reutuers.

"Less than $10 million of cash" is involved, he said in a telephone interview, while the securities are convertible into "less than 20 percent of our stock." The company now has about 7.2 million shares outstanding.
Wiedenhaupt said the price to be paid for Portescap "is below seven times its earnings before interest and taxes. "The whole deal is immediately accretive," he said.
The chief executive described Inter Scan's owner Holger Hjelm as "a long-term investor," accepting securities convertible at $17 per share.
American Precision's stock was trading at an all-time high of 14-7/8 as of 1500 EST/2000 GMT, up 3/4 for the day.
The company said it expected Portescap to have sales of $75 million this year. The acquisition is expected to close early next year.
